Name: Lumisteria Guinea Fowls
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
Welcome a new animal in your farm. This mod adds a new coop species : the guinea fowl. They drop feathers and sometimes eggs. The eggs can be used to make guinea fowl mayonnaise.

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

You can buy them as soon as you have a deluxe coop.
It's rumored that the species has another variant than the ones you could buy at Marnie's Ranch... But don't expect to see that on your first years on the valley.

Hint 1
[spoiler]Someone is familiar for selling strange eggs...[/spoiler]

Hint 2
[spoiler]On the day of the moon, after grampa's return, they may sell it... For a price[/spoiler]

Spoiler
[spoiler]Krobus will sell it the monday when on year 3 or more[/spoiler]

You will need the unofficial update of [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-4.156000/page-46#post-3356278]Better Farm Animal Variety[/url] for this mod to work.
